paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
notes: The primary target is the ALP-W model (g_aWW coupling to weak gauge bosons), but the paper also reinterprets results in an ALP-photon model (g_agamma). The provided content does not include the actual numerical exclusion contour data points (no exclusion limit table or explicit numerical limit values in the text portion provided). The main result quoted is g_aWW around 1e-4 GeV^-1 for masses up to 300 MeV, but this is the W-coupling, not g_agamma. No extractable (mass, coupling) pairs are available in the provided text. Coupling type is ambiguous: primary result is g_aWW (not in enum), with AxionPhoton being a secondary reinterpretation. | Vision: Observed 90% CL limit (blue) traced along the lower boundary of the FASER ALP-W exclusion region in image 4. The excluded region is between the lower and upper branches; the lower branch boundary is reported. X-axis in eV (MeV converted), y-axis g_aWW in 1/GeV. Lower branch reaches minimum coupling ~1.7e-5 near m_a ~ 300 MeV before curving up near the kinematic endpoint ~350-400 MeV. | Calibration: No calibration needed
